newsitem.title: USA: W.W. Grainger to acquire Canadian business.
newsitem.headline: W.W. Grainger to acquire Canadian business.

text.p: W.W. Grainger Inc said Wednesday it reached a definitive agreement to acquire the Canadian industrial distribution business of Acklands Ltd in a US$277 million transaction.
A letter of intent relating to the transaction was reported on September 10.
The Industrial Group of Acklands Ltd is Canada's largest nationwide industrial supplies distributor, with sales of more than US$299 million for the fiscal year ended January 31, 1996.

The acquisition consists of US$135 million in cash and about two million shares of W.W. Grainger common stock. The company intends to reactivate its share repurchase program in connection with this transaction.
W.W. Grainger is a large distributor of maintenance, repair and operating supplies.
